newsitem.title: USA: Former CEO to get $81.6 mln for claims vs SafeCard.
newsitem.headline: Former CEO to get $81.6 mln for claims vs SafeCard.

text.p: Peter Halmos, founder and former chief executive officer of SafeCard Services Inc, said Wednesday he will receive a total of $81.6 million, mostly from CUC International Inc, in settlement of his litigation against SafeCard.
In a statement, Halmos said CUC has agreed to pay him $70.5 million as part of the settlement of his personal injury and other claims against SafeCard and SafeCard's previous owner, Ideon Group.
CUC, a Stanford, Conn.-based direct marketing conccern, acquired Indeon in 1996. SafeCard is a large credit card protection company.
Another $7.3 million will be paid to Halmos from an escrowed SafeCard/Ideon account, he said.
Restitution of $3.8 million has already been made by SafeCard/Ideon to settle unrelated litigation, he said.
Halmos said the agreement with CUC is subject to confirmation by a Wyoming court.
In May CUC announced an $11-billion stock-swap deal to merge with HFS Inc, which operates Days Inn, Ramada hotels, and real estate companies Coldwell Banker and Century 21.
